headline: Bangladesh Bank warns against crypto and MLM financial fraud
summary: The central bank has issued a public alert regarding deceptive financial schemes operating under the guise of cryptocurrency and multi-level marketing, urging citizens to exercise caution.
details: Bangladesh Bank has issued a public warning against financial fraud schemes. These deceptive schemes are reportedly operating under the names of cryptocurrency and multi-level marketing (MLM).

The central bank advises the public to be vigilant and avoid investing in such unregulated platforms. These fraudulent activities pose significant risks to individuals' financial security and can lead to substantial losses.

It is crucial for citizens to only engage with financial institutions and investment opportunities that are officially approved and regulated by the relevant authorities. This warning aims to protect the public from potential financial harm.

headline: First prize 6 lakh taka in 124th Prize Bond draw on Sunday
summary: The 124th draw for Bangladesh Prize Bonds offers a top prize of 6 lakh taka. Participants can check results to see if their bond numbers have won.
details: The 124th series of Bangladesh Prize Bond draws is scheduled to take place this Sunday. Participants holding 100 taka Prize Bonds will have the opportunity to win various cash prizes.
The most anticipated award is the first prize, set at a substantial 6 lakh taka. This draw offers a chance for bondholders to significantly increase their savings through a tax-free lottery system.
